{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA chapters should work with post-Sanders groups such as Our Revolution or local variations thereof, Brand New Congress, etc., where relevant, to expand the anti-corporate trend in electoral politics.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA chapters should develop strong coalitions with progressive groups rooted in communities of color and the feminist, LGBTQIA+, and disability movements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Only truly multiracial electoral coalitions can build working class political power.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In 2018 there will be mass mobilization to defeat Republican rule at the state and national level, particularly among constituencies most vulnerable to the nativist, racist and anti-labor politics of the far right.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA chapters may choose to support progressive, anti-corporate candidates who do not openly identify themselves as socialists.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Concrete national support will prioritize the work of chapters backing open socialist candidates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"National DSA should prioritize cultivating and supporting socialist candidates in accordance with the long-term objective of building a mass socialist political formation in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist candidates should be accountable to DSA’s political agenda.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialist candidates can serve as the base for increasingly assertive and widespread independent socialist electoral activity in the coming years.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The development of a genuine alternative to the neoliberal third-way politics of the corporate establishment within the Democratic Party will be critical to this work.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
